title: Live broadcast list filters and paging (broadcastStatus active/upcoming/completed/all, broadcastType all/event/persistent, maxResults, pageToken)

title: Live chat message list options (hl for localized currency strings, profileImageSize 16-720)

title: search.list video filters videoEmbeddable, videoSyndicated, videoDimension, videoPaidProductPlacement and channelType
gap: native.search accepts the other video filters but not videoEmbeddable, videoSyndicated, videoDimension (2d/3d), videoPaidProductPlacement, or channelType (any/show).

title: Search the caller's own videos (forMine, includes private) or videos uploaded by this API project (forDeveloper)
gap: native.search has no forMine or forDeveloper flag, so it cannot search the authorized channel's private videos or the app's own uploads; forMine needs type=video and excludes the eight video filters.

title: Caption download format and machine translation (captions.download tfmt sbv/scc/srt/ttml/vtt or original, tlang)
gap: captions download always forces tfmt=vtt and never sends tlang, so callers cannot get SRT/TTML/SCC, the original upload format, or a machine-translated track.

title: Sized embed player HTML (videos.list maxWidth/maxHeight returning player.embedHtml, embedWidth, embedHeight)
gap: native.videos accepts the player part but not maxWidth or maxHeight, so player.embedHtml is always the default size and embedWidth/embedHeight are never returned.

title: Read specific comments or comment threads by ID (comments.list id=, commentThreads.list id=)
gap: There is no lookup by comment or thread ID; the reply path pages through every thread on the video to find a parent, which costs quota on busy videos.

title: Read another channel's sections and localized titles (channelSections.list channelId=, hl)
gap: native.channelSections list is fixed to the configured channel or a section ID; it cannot pass another channelId or hl for localized section titles.

title: Revoke a Google OAuth access or refresh token (POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke)
gap: The OAuth helpers can connect a YouTube channel but have no Google token revocation helper (the TikTok one exists), so disconnecting cannot remove the app's grant.

title: Google authorization URL options include_granted_scopes (incremental auth) and login_hint
gap: The YouTube authorize URL hard-codes access_type=offline and prompt=consent; it cannot request incremental scopes (include_granted_scopes=true) or prefill the account (login_hint).

title: Third-party AI training permission for a video (videoTrainability.get, returns permitted: all, none or a party list)
gap: Discovery revision 20261103 exposes GET /youtube/v3/videoTrainability?id= but Google has no reference page or revision-history entry yet; the SDK neither calls it nor documents it.

title: Generic abuse report (abuseReports.insert with abuseTypes, subject, relatedEntities)
gap: Discovery lists POST /youtube/v3/abuseReports with an AbuseReport body but Google publishes no reference page; only videos.reportAbuse is covered and the docs do not mention this method.

title: Channel-to-store and affiliate-program links (thirdPartyLinks list/insert/update/delete, linkingToken)
gap: Discovery exposes thirdPartyLinks (channelToStoreLink, channelToAffiliateProgramLink) with no public reference page; YouTube Shopping partners use it. The docs do not say whether it is available.

title: Flag comments as spam (comments.markAsSpam)
gap: Still in the discovery document, but deprecated (revision history 2023-09-12) and removed from the comments reference; the docs should point callers to setModerationStatus instead.

title: Content-owner delegation outside uploads (onBehalfOfContentOwner on read/live/playlist/caption methods, channels.list managedByMe, search forContentOwner, captions onBehalfOf)
gap: Partner-only content-owner parameters are accepted by most methods; the docs do not say the SDK omits them outside uploads.
